Aegis.name: Aegis
Aegis.description: This weapon can't cause Critical Injuries, can't ablate armor, and if it would reduce a target to under 1 HP it instead leaves them Unconscious on 1 HP.

Archimedes.name: Archimedes
Archimedes.description: Uses the Pilot Air Vehicle Skill instead of the Heavy Weapons Skill to fire, requires the has Targeting Scope Cyberware, and can only use Smart Rockets. It does come with one Smart Rocket included however. How nice.

ARS-5 Submachine Gun.name: ARS-5 Submachine Gun
ARS-5 Submachine Gun.description:
This heavy SMG is the complete package; it comes with a Smartgun Link, Infrared Nightvision Scope, and a Sniping Scope*.

*All three must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Big Dreem.name: Big Dreem
Big Dreem.description: Exotic SMG. Autofire only. Even if you drop the weapon, it will continue to Autofire.

Burst Flamethrower.name: Burst Flamethrower
Burst Flamethrower.description:
Can only fire Incendiary Shotgun Shells, but targets ignited by this weapon burn for 4HP a turn.

Additionally, this weapon can consume all it's remaining ammo to shoot a fireball, which explodes in a similar fashion to an incendiary grenade. The user of the weapon is also consumed by the fireball, getting Deadly on Fire*.

*Special fire mode not currently supported; will need to be manually applied

Chainknife.name: Chainknife
Chainknife.description:
Takes an action to rev up, but once revved is a powerful melee weapon. When not revved deals 2d6 damage*.

*Not revved mode not currently supported, so will need to manually reduce damage

Crusher.name: Crusher
Crusher.description: A pistol that fires shotgun shells. What's not to love.

Dragon Flamethrower.name: Dragon Flamethrower
Dragon Flamethrower.description: Fire at your finger tips. Can only fire Incendiary Shotgun Shells, but targets ignited by this weapon burn for 4HP a turn.

Enviro-launcher.name: Enviro-launcher
Enviro-launcher.description: This specially engineered rocket launcher is only capable of being fired once. However, once it has been fired the user can use an action to break of a vial attached to the launcher, which will release an enzyme that will destroy the launcher totally within an hour.

Flare Gun.name: Flare Gun
Flare Gun.description:
As well as normal Grenade Ammunition, this weapon can fire road flares*. They don't deal any damage, but if fired into the air can be seen from 3 miles. You cannot install this weapon in Pop-up Cyberware.

*Currently not supported so will need to manually delete a road flare from actors inventory after firing

Hellbringer.name: Hellbringer
Hellbringer.description: When this things shoots, you know about it. If fired by someone with less than 10 BODY, this pistol jams. An action is required to unjam it.

Hello Cutie 1TruLuv.name: Hello Cutie 1TruLuv
Hello Cutie 1TruLuv.description:
Exotic Sniper Rifle. Can load non basic ammunition.

Equipped with a Sniping Scope and Infrared Night Vision Scope*, and built-in Agent which includes a pseudo AI girlfriend who can recognize and talk to the owner.

Take good care of it/her and use it/her regularly and the weapon improves. Neglect it/her and you'll have to apologize...

* These upgrades need to be installed manually after adding to an actor

M-02 Heavy Rifle.name: M-02 Heavy Rifle
M-02 Heavy Rifle.description: This weapon fires it's own custom ammunition, priced at 500eb (Expensive) for 80 rounds of Armor-Piercing ammo.

MicroCutie by HelloCutie.name: MicroCutie by HelloCutie
MicroCutie by HelloCutie.description:
An excellent quality pistol with a unique Hypurrburst™ mode fire mode*. The weapon purrs when used. Hypurrburst™ is disabled if less than 4 bullets are in the clip.

When in Hypurrburst™ mode, the following applies

  • MicroCutie is ROF 1
  • Purrs audibly
  • Fires a single shot, drains clip, and does 4d6 damage
  • Cannot be used to make aimed shots

*Special fire mode not currently supported; will need to be manually applied

Multiple Ammunition Pistol.name: Multiple Ammunition Pistol
Multiple Ammunition Pistol.description:
A very heavy pistol capable of loading up to five different ammo types at once*, with the user able to pick between them before firing.

*Currently not supported, so users have to manually change ammo types

Nomad Air Cannon.name: Nomad Air Cannon
Nomad Air Cannon.description: Rather than normal shotgun ammunition, this weapon fires whatever liquid is placed into it. Acid can be bought for 10eb (Cheap) that reduces all armour worn by the target by 1 SP. Poison or Biotoxin can also be loaded, though requires 3 vials per shot.

Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.name: Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun
Nomad Pneumatic Bolt Gun.description: Capable of firing all Non-Basic ammunition, this weapon is still as versatile as when it was invented over two decades ago.

Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.name: Nova Model 757 Cityhunter
Nova Model 757 Cityhunter.description:
This pistol fires it's own custom rounds bought in packs of 18, though they cost the same as a pack of 10. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

Pocket Launcher.name: Pocket Launcher
Pocket Launcher.description: While unloaded, this weapon can be concealed.

SDF-45.name: SDF-45
SDF-45.description: This rocket launcher can only load Armor-Piercing rockets, and has a maximum range of 400 m/yds. When fired one rocket at a time, the GM chooses where they rockets land. When fired two rockets at a time, the GM chooses where the rockets land but this time up to 50 m/yds away from the target, and with each rocket more than 10 m/yds from each other.

SportMaster.name: SportMaster
SportMaster.description: A sport rifle, for fun, not people. Can only load Small Game Ammunition and is incapable of Autofire and Suppressive Fire.

ST-5 Assault Rifle.name: ST-5 Assault Rifle
ST-5 Assault Rifle.description: A - relatively - reliable gun. If you roll 1 on Attack (Crit fail) you must then toss a coin; if you win the gun fires as normal, while if you lose the gun jams and requires using an action to clear.

Sub-Flechette Gun.name: Sub-Flechette Gun
Sub-Flechette Gun.description:
This SMG can only fire it's own custom Armor-Piercing Ammunition, however that ammo ablates by 4 when dealing damage. Comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

SurvivalMaster.name: SurvivalMaster
SurvivalMaster.description: Exotic Assault Rifle, no Autofire, no Suppressive Fire.

Tactical Umbrella.name: Tactical Umbrella
Tactical Umbrella.description:
A stylish umbrella with pop-out weapons. Contains a Poor Quality Exotic Heavy Pistol (2 bullet capacity).

Multiple Weapon Modes: Tactical Umbrella also contains an Excellent Quality Exotic Heavy Melee Weapon.

Provides the protection of a normal umbrella (NCW pg 6)

TearJerker.name: TearJerker
TearJerker.description: This weapon can only fire Smoke or Teargas Ammunition.

Teen Dreem.name: Teen Dreem
Teen Dreem.description: This SMG can use Autofire and Suppressive Fire all the way down to it's last 2 bullets. Caution is required however, as using either firing mode well melt the gun beyond repair.

Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion.name: Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion
Timeless WW1 Rifle to Pistol Conversion.description:
Poor Quality Very Heavy Pistol.

Manual rearming of the bolt between each shot (one Action).

Triple Treat.name: Triple Treat
Triple Treat.description:
Comes with an Exotic Grenade Launcher Underbarrel* which - as the main gun is poor quality - functions as a poor quality weapon. It can't be removed. Both that and the main weapon can fire non-Basic Ammunition.

*Must be manually added after acquiring the weapon

WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.name: WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon
WAA Bullpup Assault Weapon.description:
A bullpup rifle in operation for over two decades. Can fire non-basic ammunition and comes with a Smartgun Link*.

*Smartgun Link must be manually added after acquiring the weapon
